title: Position the background image to the lower right corner of the card
goal: independently sets the repeating mode, position and size of the background image.
summary: navigation card already has an embedded decorative image. Shrink it to 96px wide, place it in the lower right corner of the card, and draw it only once.
tasks: makes the background image of .map-card non-repeating, the position is the lower right corner, the width is 96px, and the height remains proportional.
retains the background-image already written in the starting style.

example.note: position is described in horizontal and vertical directions. When the height is set to auto, the original image proportions are maintained.

hint: retains background-image; uses three other properties to cover position, size, and repetition.
